title: AgentForge Modern Local Benchmark v1
summary: Five modern, locally runnable coding models, each run fresh on all 24 audited AgentForge tasks five times through the Phase-0 runtime, one model at a time, on one Apple M4 Max through Ollama.

paid_api_cost.source: docs/campaigns/PHASE0_MODERN_LOCAL_CAMPAIGN.md §4 and §7: local only, no hosted or paid fallback; no hosted or paid service was used

environment.scope: LOCAL benchmark: every model ran on one machine through a local Ollama server. The results describe this hardware and this uniform time budget, not hosted or cloud deployment performance.

hardware.source: docs/campaigns/PHASE0_MODERN_LOCAL_CAMPAIGN.md §2 Environment (operator-recorded; the campaign artifacts record no hardware fields)

environment.hosted_api: none — no hosted or paid API was used or available as a fallback

methodology.campaign_title: AgentForge Modern Local Benchmark: sequential local cohort
methodology.seed_policy: ATLAS per-trial seed: the worker sets seed = base_seed + idx for repeat position idx (0..repetitions-1) before each trial (set_run_seed), so position idx of every (model, task) cell uses the same seed and a resumed position re-uses its original seed
methodology.request: the Phase-0 runtime's OllamaAgent calls /api/generate with only temperature and seed; every other inference setting (context length, thinking) is the Ollama server's default for that model, identical for every model of the campaign
methodology.evaluation_granularity: one fresh evaluation per (model, task) cell: tasks=[task_id], repeats=repetitions, name=<evaluation_name_prefix>:<phase>:<model>|<task_id>; phase = the model's roster phase
methodology.official_rule: the leaderboard is OFFICIAL only when every roster model is either COMPLETE (24 cells, 120 accepted runs) or explicitly classified, and at least minimum_ranked_models models are COMPLETE
methodology.ranking_method: Official rank = the AgentForge kernel's ranking by Wilson 95% lower bound (kernel/afa_kernel/ranking.py rank_by_lcb), computed by the campaign tooling (campaigns/afa_campaign/analysis.py official_baseline). Pass rate alone does not order the table.

runtime_release.rule: the launcher refuses to run when the runtime paths differ from the release tag or have uncommitted changes

evidence_scope.ownership: campaign-owned only: the active 'succeeded' ledger entry of each manifest cell whose evaluation passes every campaign check (cohort.check_cell_evaluation)
excludes: evaluations the campaign ledger does not own

methodology.model_identity_source: pinned registry digests in the frozen manifest, checked against the external Ollama inventory at every submission and acceptance (not AgentForge-persisted)

task_pins.basis: every accepted run is at its task's pinned version and content digest (checked per run by the campaign validator; the completeness receipt is complete with no problems)

not_claimed.note: The ORACLE benchmark audit rates hidden-test isolation UNVERIFIABLE for all 24 tasks: under the trusted-local sandbox the code under test can read the hidden-test file while the hidden suite runs (confirmed by the audit's isolation probe). AgentForge makes no hidden-test isolation claim; the sandbox provides workspace isolation and timeouts, not security isolation.

documented_facts.label: Runs with no applied edit
documented_facts.source: docs/campaigns/PHASE0_MODERN_LOCAL_CAMPAIGN.md §6 M4 (counted from the campaign database, which is not committed; the committed artifacts do not carry this count)

caveats.label: Protocol sensitivity
caveats.summary: Protocol sensitivity was demonstrated in a diagnosed case; the overall result reflects both coding performance and compliance with AgentForge v1's output contract.
points: 96 of 120 campaign runs produced no applied edit.
In a diagnosed reproduction, the model produced a correct code change but omitted AgentForge v1's required opening code fence, so no edit was applied.
The campaign stores no raw model responses, so that specific cause is not independently proven for all 96 runs.
The score reflects both task performance and compliance with AgentForge v1's output protocol. It is not a finding that the model has poor underlying coding capability.

caveats.label: Latency constrained
caveats.summary: Performance under the fixed local latency budget was heavily constrained.
points: 105 of 120 runs were classified as timeouts.
83 of them were full 180-second model request timeouts.

This is performance under AgentForge's uniform local time budget on this hardware (Apple M4 Max, 36 GiB). It should not be read as a general conclusion about the model's capability or about its performance in other environments.

caveats.label: Not comparable with historical results
caveats.summary: Historical results are not directly comparable with Modern Local v1. Eighteen of the 24 task definitions changed and the historical runs predate the current evaluation-integrity system.
points: The 720 pre-Phase-0 runs used older versions of 18 of the 24 tasks, a different runtime path and, for some models, other generation settings.
The two result sets are never pooled. qwen3.5:9b appears in both; its equal 40/120 counts are a coincidence on different benchmark definitions.
